title: Controlled geometric features on 3D surfaces with constructed metric reference and auditable lineage
purpose: Machine-readable public interface and validation boundary for the MethodsX reproducibility package.

neutral_provider.rule: observable when the binding contains at least one primary-valid projected station

validation_gates.name: geometric consistency
validation_gates.scope: station-level materialized boundary separation versus prescribed width
validation_gates.interpretation: internal materialization-consistency check; not independent surface-accuracy validation

validation_gates.name: lineage completeness
validation_gates.scope: feature-level closure across design, materialized geometry, reference, bindings and observable projected outputs

validation_gates.name: reference consistency
validation_gates.scope: feature-level constructed metric reference versus prescribed width and frozen expected reference
validation_gates.interpretation: internal feature-aggregation consistency; not an external metrological reference

validation_gates.name: view coverage
validation_gates.scope: complete 480 feature-view binding population and reproduced mask-based observability states

morphology_boundary: Feature family and associated parameters characterize the design-level centerline. Preservation of prescribed family morphology, curvature or centerline shape after surface placement/materialization is not a validation gate.
